visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a steaming bowl of milky white soup containing fish fillets, clams, and tofu, garnished with fresh green onions. Large red and white text overlays the center of the frame. (2) A pair of hands is shown peeling a large white radish with a peeler over a yellow cutting board. The radish is then sliced into thick rounds and further into quarter-slices using a sharp steel knife. (3) A block of firm white tofu is sliced into even cubes on the board. The cubes are then gently placed into a pink ceramic bowl filled with water to prevent them from breaking. (4) A clear broth is poured from a stainless steel bowl into a red cast-iron pot on an induction stove. The sliced radish pieces are added to the pot using a metal mesh strainer. (5) A raw sea bass fillet with silver-grey skin is placed on a black cutting board and sliced into three equal sections. The knife moves with precision, showing the texture of the fish. (6) Noodles are boiled in a separate floral-patterned pot and then transferred to a white serving bowl with a red and blue decorative rim. (7) Clams are added to the simmering soup in the red pot. Once they open, the fish fillets are carefully placed into the broth to poach. (8) The final dish is assembled by pouring the hot broth over the noodles and arranging the fish, clams, and tofu on top. (9) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a white shirt and a pink apron, is shown in a medium shot eating the dish. She uses chopsticks and a spoon, expressing great satisfaction through smiles and nodding.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 非常好喝又健康的『鱸魚蘿蔔湯』下集❤️😊. (2) [Subtitle]: 將蘿蔔刨去2~3層皮皮. (3) [Subtitle]: 取用2分之一. (4) [Subtitle]: 切成小塊、薄片可以更快煮透. (5) [Subtitle]: 豆腐切成方塊. (6) [Subtitle]: 先放入水裡泡一下豆腐比較不會破. (7) [Subtitle]: 將『鱸魚高湯』倒入鍋中 (作法請看上一集). (8) [Subtitle]: 把蘿蔔片放進來. (9) [Subtitle]: 加入適量的水稀釋高湯. (10) [Subtitle]: 慢慢的煮滾滾了大約再煮五分鐘即可. (11) [Subtitle]: 倒掉豆腐水輕輕放入鍋裡. (12) [Subtitle]: 中小火慢慢的煮豆腐才會嫩... (13) [Subtitle]: 一旁來切鱸魚片. (14) [Subtitle]: 腹肉的刺比較多我來吃😋. (15) [Subtitle]: 其餘切成三等份. (16) [Subtitle]: 想增加飽足感可以煮點麵... (17) [Subtitle]: 將煮好的麵放入碗裡. (18) [Subtitle]: 豆腐浮起來就是煮好囉😉. (19) [Subtitle]: 現在放入蛤蜊，火轉大一點點. (20) [Subtitle]: 煮到蛤蜊開口就把火轉到最小. (21) [Subtitle]: 好吃又嫩的魚肉就是要小小火慢慢的泡熟. (22) [Subtitle]: 絕對不可以用大火煮滾這樣魚肉會變硬，也會散掉. (23) [Subtitle]: 像這樣慢慢的煮直到魚肉表面顏色轉白就可以關火了. (24) [Subtitle]: 放一點生蒜末、蔥花增加風味跟營養！😊. (25) [Subtitle]: 將熱熱的湯淋上來激發香味😋. (26) [Subtitle]: 接著把嫩豆腐、蛤蜊、魚肉擺上來❤️. (27) [Subtitle]: 乳白色的鱸魚湯美極了❤️. (28) [Subtitle]: 非常好喝又健康的『鱸魚蘿蔔湯』就完成啦~😊. (29) [Subtitle]: 加上麵更有飽足感✅. (30) [Subtitle]: 那我要開動囉😋. (31) [Subtitle]: 魚湯帶有魚的鮮味還有蘿蔔的清甜真的很好喝❤️😋. (32) [Subtitle]: 魚肉也超嫩❤️❤️. (33) [Subtitle]: 好喝的鱸魚蘿蔔湯加上麵就更有飽足感了. (34) [Subtitle]: 吃麵秀...太難表演了...哈哈.... (35) [Subtitle]: 總之，就是很好吃的意思啦~. (36) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinasKitchen ❤️😊.

(2) Rhythmic, percussive thudding sounds of a knife against a cutting board are heard as the radish is sliced. The music maintains its energetic tempo. (3) A clear splashing sound accompanies the pouring of broth, followed by the metallic clinking of a strainer being moved in the pot. (4) Subdued boiling and bubbling noises are layered beneath the music during the cooking segments. (5) A crisp, sharp slicing sound occurs as the fish is prepared on the board. (6) Towards the end, a friendly female voice speaks in Traditional Chinese, expressing enjoyment. (7) Audible slurping sounds occur as the woman eats the noodles, followed by a lighthearted, genuine giggle and some soft conversational vocalizations. (8) The music fades out gradually as the video concludes.
